name: Hierarchical Sampling for Hemispherical Wavefronts
definition: A coarse-to-fine sampling scheme for 2D hemispherical wavefronts to balance reconstruction quality and computational overhead.
summary: Hierarchical Sampling for Hemispherical Wavefronts is a coarse-to-fine, differentiable 2D sampling scheme for NLOS imaging that balances quality and overhead by addressing hemispherical resampling intractability.
